purpose: Determine whether the quadrature scalar changes the highest-derivative Einstein-aether physical-mode block on the frozen static W=0 branch, combine the two independently derived reduced symbols only where derivative-order factorization is exact, and retain every gauge, constraint, endpoint, strong-coupling, background, and observational blocker.

frozen_background_contract.metric: constant local Einstein-frame Minkowski metric with signature (-,+,+,+)
frozen_background_contract.scalar_jet: constant spacelike v_mu=partial_mu phibar orthogonal to Ubar, with Wbar=Ubar^mu v_mu/(Mpl a0)=0 and 0<s=alpha sqrt(Zbar)<1/2
frozen_background_contract.matter: vacuum principal sector; physical matter and photons define the comparison cone but contribute no background derivative block
frozen_background_contract.coefficient_freeze: all background coefficients are frozen locally when extracting the homogeneous degree-two derivative symbol
frozen_background_contract.solution_status: the constant nonzero scalar jet is a local off-shell coefficient probe unless separate background equations and boundary data are solved

derivative_order_audit.scalar_density: L_phi=F(Z)+B(Z,varphi)W^2 with Z=(g^munu+U^mu U^nu)partial_mu phi partial_nu phi/Lambda^2 and W=U^mu partial_mu phi/Lambda
derivative_order_audit.scalar_derivative_dependencies: L_phi contains first derivatives of phi but no derivatives of g_munu or U^mu; g and U enter Z and W algebraically
derivative_order_audit.static_branch_quadratic_result: At Wbar=0, the degree-two derivative Hessian has a scalar-scalar block but exactly zero scalar-to-partial-U and scalar-to-partial-g blocks. Terms involving delta U, delta g, or derivatives of them carry at most one perturbation derivative and are lower principal order.
derivative_order_audit.einstein_aether_dependency: The Einstein-Hilbert plus Einstein-aether derivative block contains the known metric-vector mixing but no scalar derivative, so the scalar adds no reciprocal degree-two derivative block.
derivative_order_audit.factorization_scope: After applying the already committed pure-aether gauge/constraint reduction, the physical principal determinant factors into its five-mode determinant times the one-scalar factor on this frozen branch.
derivative_order_audit.exclusions: This does not prove factorization at Wbar nonzero, across varying coefficients, in a matter derivative background, or for an unreduced gauge/constraint formulation.

reduced_principal_factorization.scalar_coefficients: C=alpha^2 s/(1-2s), K=2 alpha^2 s(1-s)/(1-2s)^2, A=exp(-4varphi)K
reduced_principal_factorization.aether_factor: P_EA is the committed product of two spin-2, two spin-1, and one spin-0 gauge/constraint-reduced physical factors
reduced_principal_factorization.combined_factor: P_reduced=P_EA*P_phi, up to nonzero frozen normalization factors
reduced_principal_factorization.strong_hyperbolicity_boundary: Diagonalizable physical factors with positive kinetic coefficients establish only the restricted constant-coefficient reduced physical sector; the full gauge-fixed PDE and constraint subsystem are not established.

finite_locus_contract.aether_result: all five pure-aether squared speeds are one and their reduced kinetic/energy coefficients are positive
finite_locus_contract.physical_alignment: varphi=0 makes the universal physical photon cone equal to the local Einstein cone
finite_locus_contract.scalar_result: c_parallel^2=1 and c_perp^2=(1-2s)/(2(1-s)) lies strictly between zero and one for 0<s<1/2
finite_locus_contract.combined_result: all six reduced physical modes have real positive characteristic speeds no larger than the physical photon speed on the finite locus
finite_locus_contract.exact_limit: epsilon to zero approaches exact preferred-frame cancellation but removes the spin-1 and spin-0 kinetic margin

obstruction_contract.preferred_frame: exact c13=alpha1=alpha2=0 remains on c14=c123=0 and is singular
obstruction_contract.scalar_low_gradient: A, K, and C vanish as s approaches zero, so the scalar principal block degenerates
obstruction_contract.scalar_endpoint: A, K, and C diverge as s approaches one half, so the finite-gradient endpoint is not regular
obstruction_contract.background: no global static, Solar, compact-object, lensing, or FLRW solution realizes the frozen coefficient patch
obstruction_contract.constraints: the unreduced metric-vector gauge and constraint evolution, nonlinear caustics, shock formation, and a common global Cauchy surface remain unproved
obstruction_contract.cutoff: no uniform strong-coupling or EFT cutoff stays positive as epsilon or s approaches its singular limits
obstruction_contract.observations: no observational row is opened and no Solar, GW, binary-pulsar, cosmology, or lensing likelihood is evaluated
